entities.name: Jodi Bieber
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jodi Bieber is a South African photographer. Her photograph of Bibi Aisha, a woman from Afghanistan whose ears and nose were severed by her husband and brother-in-law, was selected as the World Press Photo of the Year in 2010.
